ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
Triangle $ ABC$ is an isosceles triangle with $ \overline{AB} =\overline{BC}$. Point $ D$ is the midpoint of both $ \overline{BC}$ and $ \overline{AE}$, and $ \overline{CE}$ is 11 units long. Triangle $ ABD$ is congruent to triangle $ ECD$. What is the length of $ \overline{BD}$?

method.method_draft: Set up an algebraic length variable centered at D. From the image, identify BC as the segment passing through D, so write BD = x. From the text, D is the midpoint of BC, so DC = x and BC = 2x. The congruence triangle ABD ≅ triangle ECD gives AB = EC by the vertex order A ↔ E, B ↔ C, D ↔ D. Since EC = 11, AB = 11. The isosceles condition AB = BC then gives BC = 11, so 2x = 11 and x = 5.5. Therefore BD = 5.5.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中 A 在左下方，C 在右下方，B 在左上方，E 在右上方；线段 BC 从 B 到 C 经过交点 D，线段 AE 也经过 D，两个三角形 ABD 和 ECD 位于交叉线段两侧。推理：设 BD = x。因为 D 是 BC 的 midpoint，所以 DC = x，BC = BD + DC = 2x。由题目给出 triangle ABD congruent to triangle ECD，按对应顺序 A ↔ E，B ↔ C，D ↔ D，因此对应边 AB = EC。已知 CE = 11，所以 AB = 11。又因为 triangle ABC 是等腰三角形且 AB = BC，所以 BC = 11。于是 2x = 11，解得 x = 5.5。因此 BD = 5.5。
